This release cuts the work Teletextarr does, both while you watch and while you don't.

## Nothing runs while nobody is watching
Before this release, every page refreshed its data around the clock: RSS feeds every 10 minutes, and the weather, TV guide and media server pages every minute, even with no viewers. Now:
- A page fetches data only while someone is watching it.
- If its data is stale when someone tunes in, it's refreshed straight away.
- When nobody is watching anything, the refresh thread sleeps until a viewer arrives.
- An index page also keeps its headline source page fresh.
- Previews (`/preview/<page>.png`) fetch what they need too.

Set `server.refresh_when_idle: true` if you'd rather keep everything up to date all the time.

## One encoder per page, shared
- **Shared:** everyone watching a page now shares a single encoder, instead of each viewer starting their own.
- **No double start:** Plex and Jellyfin open a channel twice when you tune in, a quick probe and then the real stream. The encoder now stays up for `server.linger_seconds` (default 10) after the last viewer leaves, so the second connection reuses it.
- **Fast start:** a new viewer is sent the last couple of seconds of output first, so playback starts at a keyframe without waiting.
- **No stuck encoders:** a viewer whose connection stalls is dropped after 30 seconds rather than leaving an encoder running.

## Cheaper streams
- **Audio:** the silent track is now mono AAC at 32 kbps, down from stereo at 64 kbps.
- **Measured costs:** on a Broadwell Xeon, a viewer costs about 25% of one core at 25 fps and 13% at 10 fps. `server.fps` lets you trade smoothness for power; teletext pages barely move, so 10 fps looks the same on most clients.
- **Why not the GPU?** We measured NVIDIA's NVENC as an alternative. It saves CPU but takes the GPU from idle (5 W) to full power (18.6 W), so encoding on the CPU stays the frugal choice.

## Upgrading
Nothing to change: the new options default to the new behaviour. Pull `ghcr.io/lgulliver/teletextarr:0.2.0` and restart.
